final_boss_adjustment.reason: The original final party no longer depends on Caterpie or random non-damaging moves; a custom Quick Attack preserves both normal victory and deterministic HP=1 defeat/retry for all partners.

scope: Original milestone art and balanced Cerrado battle. Reusing the Caterpie slot also replaces inherited Caterpie appearances elsewhere with Lobo-guara. The shiny palette repeats the normal palette; cry, Pokedex text/category and habitat maps remain inherited or provisional.
